description: This file defines the ContentWrapper interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.content.content package, providing static utility methods for content handling such as retrieving default MIME types, extracting candidate field values from model objects, and encoding content values.

classes.name: ContentWrapper
classes.description: Interface providing static methods for content management, including retrieving default MIME types, extracting field values, and encoding content.

methods.name: getDefaultMimeTypeId
methods.description: Returns the default MIME type ID from properties, with a fallback to 'text/html; charset=utf-8'.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field named after the contentTypeId from a GenericValue model object.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate field value from a specific entity identified by modelEntityName and primary key, with optional caching.

methods.name: encodeContentValue
methods.description: Encodes a content string using the specified encoder type, sanitizing the value.
